headline: Thursday and Friday Pressers
deck: Emiliano Martínez back from a jaw injury and training well, Chelsea to decide on him on Saturday
body:
Emiliano Martínez is back from a jaw injury and training well, Xabi Alonso said on Friday.

Chelsea will decide on him after Saturday's session, their last before Sunday.

men.name: Emiliano Martínez
men.note: back from a jaw injury; training well, decision after Saturday's session

quote.text: Tomorrow, we have the last training session before Sunday. We will decide. He’s training well.

teamNews.line: Aaron Wan-Bissaka is close to a return from his hamstring injury and Matty Cash is suspended, with the rest of the squad thought to be available.

men.name: Aaron Wan-Bissaka
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; close, training assessed Saturday

quote.text: Aaron is close and tomorrow we’ll see if he’s training normally and feeling good.

teamNews.line: Alex Scott has rejoined team training with sprinting and shooting tests still to come, while Alex Tóth, Julián Araujo and Juanlu Sánchez all miss out.

men.name: Alex Tóth
men.note: hamstring

men.name: Julián Araujo
men.note: thigh

men.name: Juanlu Sánchez
men.note: ankle

men.name: Alex Scott
men.note: back from a tendon injury; training with the team, load not yet full, decision by Sunday

quote.text: He has started to train with the team. His load is still not at 100%, so we need to do the last steps and the last tests.

teamNews.line: Saša Lukić is available again after a groin injury.

men.name: Saša Lukić
men.note: back from a groin injury

teamNews.line: Bukayo Saka faces weeks out with a quad injury, Mikel Merino misses out and Max Dowman is banned, while Ezri Konsa has recovered.

men.name: Bukayo Saka
men.note: weeks; quad, more activity only after the international break

men.name: Ezri Konsa
men.note: back in contention; taken out as a precaution, now feeling good

quote.text: After the international break, he’s going to start hitting the pitch and start to have more activity, see how he feels. But unfortunately, he’s going to be out for a while.

teamNews.line: Ryan Gravenberch is the lone doubt, his fitness a question of whether he can manage the pain.

quote.text: The only doubt we will have is Ryan. The others will be the same as we have been.

teamNews.line: Tosin returns from a calf injury and Rodrigo Bentancur is suspended.

men.name: Tosin
men.note: back from a calf injury; rejoined the group Thursday

quote.text: Tosin is available; yesterday he came inside of the group.

teamNews.line: Carlos Baleba is out for a number of weeks, Marcus Rashford and Luke Shaw also miss out and Lisandro Martínez is banned, while Patrick Dorgu is being eased back from his hamstring trouble.

men.name: Marcus Rashford
men.note: hip

men.name: Patrick Dorgu
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; very little training, weekend undecided

men.name: Carlos Baleba
men.note: a number of weeks; beyond the international break

quote.text: Carlos, we don’t know exactly [the severity], but it’ll be a number of weeks.

teamNews.line: Regis Le Bris is without Omar Alderete through suspension.
Jean-Philippe Mateta is banned and Ismaïla Sarr is due back after the international break.

quote.text: He will come back after the international break.

teamNews.line: Nico O’Reilly is short of full fitness with a back problem and will spend the international break on therapy.

quote.text: The break is what he needs, to use the break to do the right things in terms of therapy and these kind of things, and be 100% after the international break.

teamNews.line: Jacob Ramsey is suspended and Joelinton awaits a treatment plan that will set the length of his absence.

quote.text: Joelinton, unfortunately, went out with an injury again. We need to make the final treatment plan for him to see how long he will be out.

teamNews.line: Nicolás Domínguez faces up to eight weeks out after a re-injury, Igor Jesus is back from his calf problem and Nicolò Savona has rejoined training after seven months, with Daniel Muñoz a doubt.

men.name: Nicolò Savona
men.note: back from a knee injury; load managed, minutes due in a friendly over the break

men.name: Igor Jesus
men.note: back from a calf injury; trained all week, no reaction

men.name: Nicolás Domínguez
men.note: up to eight weeks; muscle, setback and re-injury

men.name: Daniel Muñoz
men.note: minor issues; looks okay and has trained

quote.text: Nico Domínguez joined training as well. Unfortunately, he had a setback and a re-injury, so he will be out for up to eight weeks now.

teamNews.line: Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva are both training again after knee and hamstring trouble, though neither is being rushed, and Yehor Yarmoliuk is suspended.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from a knee injury; probably not yet, training consistently

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; a little closer, to be built up

quote.text: Antoni, probably not just yet. He’s trained pretty consistently over the last week, 10 days.

teamNews.line: Anton Stach is a major doubt with a broken toe and Dominic Calvert-Lewin hopes to train again after a foot setback, while Joe Rodon is back in full training.

men.name: Dominic Calvert-Lewin
men.note: foot; setback, hoped back in training Friday

men.name: Anton Stach
men.note: broken toe; individual rehab only, a major doubt

men.name: Joe Rodon
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; full team training, in the squad if ready

men.name: Gabriel Gudmundsson
men.note: back in contention; has trained, no problem

men.name: James Justin
men.note: back in contention; has trained, no problem

quote.text: Dominic Calvert-Lewin had a little setback with his foot, as well, and wasn’t able to train with us today, but with him, I’d say I am carefully optimistic that he’s back in training hopefully tomorrow. Then, he would also be available.

teamNews.line: Jack Grealish is unavailable for Friday's match but is due to work with the squad again soon.

men.name: Jack Grealish
men.note: back in contention soon; not available Friday

quote.text: I wouldn’t give you the plan [on his reintegration] but we will be working with Jack again soon.

teamNews.line: Hidemasa Morita may miss a few weeks with a recurring groin problem, Elliot Stroud is out with a knee injury and Matt Crooks is banned, but Jack Butland is back from his shoulder injury.

men.name: Jack Butland
men.note: back from a shoulder injury

men.name: Hidemasa Morita
men.note: possibly a few weeks; groin, same leg, scanned

men.name: Elliot Stroud
men.note: knee

quote.text: He felt something after Ipswich. [He’s had] a scan; maybe a few weeks he will be out.
